central_question: Can semantic interaction dynamics and structural orchestration produce useful cooperation hypotheses while remaining explainable, recoverable, and governed?
assumptions: Physical position and semantic interaction state are separate spaces.
Semantic state has exploration, construction, cooperation, and caution dimensions.
The small fixture uses all-to-all semantic neighbors; a larger world needs a measured neighborhood index.
RWO owns deterministic structural transitions while the runtime owns accepted history and recovery.
Model output is hypothesis evidence and never permission, policy, or scientific truth.
